The UK is in its third heatwave of the year, with UK A&E attendances hitting a record 81,264 in June and school absences in England reaching nearly 20% during the heatwave — June 26 was the highest daily absence rate of the 2025/26 academic year. Wildfires are ravaging France and Spain; a French nuclear reactor has shut down due to extreme heat. Barcelona recorded its highest temperature in 112 years, with some Spanish stations hitting 44°C. Estimates suggest the continent-wide death toll from June's heatwave could exceed 20,000, with ~5,000 excess deaths in Germany alone and thousands more in France, Spain and Belgium. Ireland has issued high temperature warnings. Globally, June 2025 was the second-hottest June on record (16.54°C), behind June 2024 (16.66°C).
